chunks: Sa'd narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who became junub, then performed tayammum, and led us in prayer while we were in a state of taharah. He said: There is no problem with that.

key_terms.أَجْنَبَ: became in a state of janabah requiring ritual purification
key_terms.تَيَمَّمَ: performed tayammum as a substitute form of ritual purification
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no objection or problem with it

ai.seo_question: Can a person who performed tayammum after janabah lead in prayer those who have wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning congregational salat when the Imam has performed tayammum after janabah while the followers have wudu (ablution) or taharah. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem in such an arrangement, indicating the validity of the prayer behind one purified by tayammum.
